Inventory Items

The Find & Merge feature helps you identify and consolidate duplicate inventory items in your system.

This tool is useful when you have created multiple inventory items that represent the same physical product, which can happen during data import or manual entry.

How Merging Works

When you merge inventory items, all transaction history from the duplicate items will be combined into a single item, maintaining accurate inventory records and simplifying your item list.

The merge process preserves all historical data, including quantities, costs, and transaction dates, ensuring your financial records remain accurate.

Using Find & Merge

To use this feature, select the duplicate items you want to merge together, then choose which item should be kept as the primary record.

The other items will be merged into the primary item and removed from your inventory list.

Important: Merging is permanent and cannot be undone. Review your selections carefully before confirming the merge.
